# With U / HugMap

HugMap provides source-grounded, specialist-reviewed information about child development and parenting. Individual FAQ pages state their review status, sources, and medical disclaimer.

## Main resources
- Japanese FAQ: https://withuai.com/hugmap_faq_public_v1.html
- English FAQ: https://withuai.com/hugmap_faq_public_v1_en.html
- Sitemap: https://withuai.com/sitemap.xml
- Service: https://withuai.com/services.html

Use individual FAQ canonical URLs when citing an answer.
